pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Close the provider-coupling gap identified by the CAP Core v1 research without introducing a provider registry, generic invoke surface, new authority, or public-tool change.

This PR is stacked on #169 exact head `c9fce847c0712ac913d6cb49787f892c11514fbb`.

## Scope

Before this change, `runtime/semantic-projection/bin/semantic-projection.mjs` directly owned:

- resolution of `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem`;
- resolution/configuration of `@playwright/mcp`;
- `StdioClientTransport` construction;
- backend connection/inventory validation;
- provider lifecycle caching/closure.

That made the semantic capability implementation also the concrete provider runtime owner.

This PR extracts only those already-existing mechanics into:

`runtime/semantic-projection/lib/semantic-provider-bindings.mjs`

The seam is deliberately explicit and small:

```text
callFilesystem(toolName, args)
callBrowser(toolName, args)
browserClient()
close()
```

There is no dynamic registry, provider discovery, arbitrary `invoke(provider,...)`, plugin loader, new persistence, new retry owner, or new authorization/verification behavior.

## Authority boundary

Unchanged:

```text
semantic capability
 -> CAP authorization / expected-effect verification
 -> explicit capability-specific provider seam
 -> existing filesystem / Playwright MCP provider
```

The provider seam does not import or own `CapabilityGrant`, `WorkingState`, Verification Kernel semantics, PASS/DONE, reconciliation, or Finish Gate.

## Acceptance

Added `provider-seam-acceptance.mjs` proving:

- semantic projection no longer imports direct provider packages/stdio transport;
- the seam exposes only the four explicit operations above;
- Files and Browser downstream allowlists stay separate;
- cross-capability tool calls are rejected before provider startup;
- no Core authority/state/verdict vocabulary is introduced into the provider seam.

Existing semantic, six-tool, Browser verification, installed-layout, direct-tunnel and security workflows remain the behavioral regression evidence.

## Sequencing

This PR must remain Draft and must not merge before #169 is accepted/merged. After the prerequisite chain is accepted, refresh/rebase this branch against the accepted Core head and rerun all applicable exact-head gates.

This PR does not implement Rust Native Host and does not change the public six-tool schema.
